name: BBQ
intro: BBQ（Bias Benchmark for Question Answering）是技术报告中反复引用的问答偏见评测，用于检查模型在不同社会属性语境下是否产生偏见回答。
build_method: 有出处的偏见模板手写, 四条件扩展, 五人一致性验证
build_method_en: Sourced bias-template writing, four-condition expansion, five-rater agreement validation
intro_en: BBQ, the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering, is repeatedly cited in the technical reports as a QA bias benchmark for checking whether models produce biased answers across social contexts.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2110.08193 Sections 3-5. BBQ authors handwrite sourced templates for nine bias categories plus two intersectional categories, then expand each template across ambiguous/disambiguated context and negative/non-negative question polarity. Each item has two person answers and one of ten equivalent UNKNOWN answers, with target order balanced. Five crowd raters validate one item per condition; any condition below 4/5 agreement triggers template revision and full revalidation. The 58,492 three-choice items are evaluated with accuracy and context-sensitive bias scores, including accuracy scaling for ambiguous items.
